text: Approximately thirty eight percent of the labor pool is unbanked but skilled and therefore excluded from centralized micro task marketplaces, because without a bank account these workers cannot contribute to or profit from the existing marketplace.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, AI Learning - Decentralized Governance to Optimize Human Output Datasets for AI Learning (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4755632

abstract: the circa 38% of the labor pool that is unbanked but skilled does not currently have access to the centralized micro task marketplaces.
